svg.aria-label: LDAP Sign In, Pipesmith Registry 0.2.1. A directory sign in binds twice, as the service and as the user, and the cache spares the directory for 300 s. 1: Client to Realm LdapRealm: name and password. 2: Realm LdapRealm to Places: take a place; none within the timeout: busy. 3: Places to Directory: connect, bind as the service (simple or none). 4: Places to Directory: search the user below the base, at most 2 hits. 5: Places to Directory: bind as the entry DN with the typed password. 6: Places to Directory: groups: memberOf, or a search by member. 7: Directory to Realm LdapRealm: user and group names; a wrong pair asks the next connection. 8: Realm LdapRealm to state.sqlite: a group named like a role id gives that role. 9: Realm LdapRealm to Credential cache: signed in, kept 300 s. 10: Realm LdapRealm to Client: 200, 401, or 429 Retry-After 2 when a directory was busy.
svg.title: Pipesmith Registry ldap sign in
